author: Paul Nation
introFa: کتاب «4000 Essential English Words 1 (2nd Edition)» نوشته Paul Nation یکی از منابع ارزشمند و معتبر برای یادگیری زبان انگلیسی در سطح A2 است. این اثر با ساختاری منسجم و غنی، شما را در تسلط بر واژگان و درک مطلب یاری می‌کند.
readingTipsFa: پیش از مطالعه هر بخش از کتاب «4000 Essential English Words 1 (2nd Edition)»، نگاهی سریع به تیترها و ساختار آن بیندازید.
واژگان و اصطلاحات جدید را در زمینه و بافت جمله یادداشت کنید تا در حافظه بلندمدت تثبیت شوند.
پس از پایان هر فصل، نکات کلیدی و آموخته‌های خود را مرور کرده و به زبان خود خلاصه کنید.

content: 1 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 1 Word Part Definition agree v. to have the same opinion or belief as another person alcohol n. a type of drink that can make people drunk arrive v. to get somewhere August n. the eighth month of the year boat n. a vehicle that moves across water breakfast n. the morning meal camera n. a piece of equipment that takes pictures capital n. a city where a country’s government is based catch v. to grab or get something duck n. a small water bird enjoy v. to like something invite v. to ask someone to come to a place or event love v. to like something or someone a lot month n. one of 12 periods of time in one year travel v. to go to a faraway place on vacation or business typical adj. it is normal, or something that usually happens visit v. to go and spend time in another place or see another person weather n. the temperature and the state of the outdoors week n. a period of time that is seven days long wine n. an alcoholic drink made from grapes

2 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 2 Word Part Definition adventure n. a fun or exciting thing that you do approach v. to move close to it carefully adv. with great attention, especially to detail or safety chemical n. something that scientists use in chemistry create v. to make something new evil adj. something or someone bad or cruel, not good experiment n. a test that you do to see what will happen kill v. to make them die laboratory n. a room where a scientist works laugh n. the sound made when someone is happy or a funny thing occurs loud adj. strong and very easy to hear nervous adj. they think something bad will happen noise n. an unpleasant sound project n. a type of work that you do for school or a job scare v. to make them feel afraid secret n. something that you do not tell other people shout v. to say something loudly smell v. to use your nose to sense it terrible adj. it is very bad worse adj it is of poorer quality than another thing

3 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 3 Word Part Definition alien n. a creature from a different world among prep. they are all around you chart n. a list of information cloud n. a group of water drops in the sky describe v. to say or write what someone or something is like ever adv. at any time fail v. you do not succeed in what you try to do grade n. a score or mark given to someone’s work instead adv. in place of library n. a place where you go to read books photograph n. a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print planet n. a large round thing in space report n. something someone writes for school or work several adj. more than two but not many shape n. the arrangement of its sides and surfaces solve v. to find an answer to it suddenly adv. it happens quickly and unexpectedly suppose v. to guess understand v. you need to know what it means view v. to look at something

4 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 4 Word Part Definition appropriate adj. it is right or normal avoid v. to stay away from it behave v. to act in a particular way, especially to be good calm adj. they do not get excited or upset concern n. a feeling of worry content adj. to be happy and not want more expect v. to happen, you believe it will happen frequently adv. it happens often habit n. a thing that you do often instruct v. to teach issue n. an important topic none pron. not any of something patient adj. they don’t become angry or upset easily positive adj. it is good punish v. to make someone suffer for breaking the rules or laws represent v. to speak or act for a person or group shake v. to move back and forth or up and down quickly spread v. to move out to cover a larger area stroll v. to walk slowly and calmly village n. a very small town

5 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 5 Word Part Definition active adj. they move a lot or have a lot of things to do adult n. a person who is more than 18 years old age n. how many years someone has lived bad adj. it is not good balance n. when two or more things are equal bike n. a vehicle with two wheels powered by a human choose v. to pick something or make a decision doctor n. a person who studies medicine and helps sick people during prep. while the event was happening football n. a sport with eleven members and an oval- shaped ball fun adj. it is enjoyable game n. an activity where people compete against each other heart n. an organ that keeps the body alive golf n. a sport with clubs and a small white ball increase v. to make something larger life n. the time when a person is alive kilometer n. a unit of measurement that is 1,000 meters often adv. when something happens many times plenty pron. there is a lot of it weight n. how heavy something or someone is

6 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 6 Word Part Definition apart adj. they are not next to each other attribute n. a characteristic of a person or thing bilingual adj. person can speak two languages completely adv. very, very different from before dash v. to run or move quickly disgust n. a feeling of distaste and anger caused by something rude or unpleasant fashionable adj. what people like to wear and do now foreign adj. something we are not used to gulf n. a gap between people who do not understand each other mirror n. usually made of glass, and you can see yourself in it natural adj. not made by people nowadays adv. at the present time participant n. someone who joins in a social event or competition ritual n. a formal custom that people do regularly spoken adj. what we say sport n. games like running, jumping, football, and tennis surprised adj. when something unexpected happens tense adj. you are not comfortable and feel unhappy totally adv. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent vague adj. it is not clear and gives very few details

7 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 7 Word Part Definition allow v. to let it happen announce v. to make it known beside prep. next to you challenge n. something difficult to complete claim v. to say that something is true condition n. the state that they are in contribute v to do something to make it successful difference n. a way that something is not like other things divide v. to split it into smaller parts expert n. who is very good at doing something famous adj. well known force n. a person’s strength or power harm n. to hurt someone or damage something lay v. to put or place in a horizontal or flat position peace n. a time without war prince n. the son of a king protect v. to stop them from getting hurt sense v. to know about it without being told sudden adj. it happens very quickly therefore adv. for this reason

8 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 8 Word Part Definition accept v. to take it arrange v. to put them in the right place attend v. to go to it chase v. you run after them and try to catch them contrast n. a sharp difference between two things encourage v. to make them want to do something familiar adj. those you know well grab v. to take a hold of someone or something suddenly hang v. to keep it above the ground huge adj. very big necessary adj. you must do it pattern n. a way in which something is done or organized propose v. to say that it should be done purpose n. the reason that you do something release v. to stop holding it require v. to say that it is necessary satisfied adj. when you have what you wanted single adj. there is only one tear v. to pull it apart theory n. an idea about how something works

9 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 9 Word Part Definition animal n. a living thing that can move bus n. a large vehicle that people travel on cat n. a small animal related to lions and tigers that is kept as a pet command n. an order given to a person or animal to do something depend v. to need it for support or help dog n. an animal with four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet or trained to work door n. an object that swings or slides open and shut friend n. someone a person knows and likes spending time with hear v. to be aware of sound through your ears help v. to do something that makes something easier for someone else horse n. a big, strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things hospital n. where sick or hurt people receive care leg n. a body part used for standing and walking medical adj. related to the treatment of an injury or disease open v. to move something so that an opening is not covered pull v. to hold onto something to move it toward rabbit n. a small animal with long ears that lives in a hole in the ground school n. a place where children go to learn see v. to use your eyes to look at something or someone service n. the act of helping or serving someone

10 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 10 Word Part Definition benefit n. a good thing certain adj you know it is true chance n. an opportunity to do something effect n. a change made by something else essential adj. it is very important and necessary far adj. it is not close focus v. to think about it and pay attention to it function n. what it does grass n. the green leaves that cover the ground guard v. to take care of it image n. a picture of it immediate adj. it happens quickly primary adj. it is the most important thing proud adj. happy about what they have done remain v. to stay there rest v. to stop being active while the body gets back its strength separate adj. they are not together site n. a place tail n. a part of an animal’s body that sticks out from its rear or back trouble n. a problem or a difficulty

11 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 11 Word Part Definition advertise v. to describe or draw attention to a product or event by using a public medium aware adj. they know that something or a situation exists battery n. an object placed inside something to supply it with electricity black adj. the darkest color city n. a place where a lot of people live clean v. to make something neat and tidy country n. an area of land with the same government and laws develop v. to make something larger or more advanced electric adj. it uses electricity eventually adv. something happens at a later time or in the end fact n. a piece of information that is true glass n. a transparent, breakable material history n. the study of the past nature n. everything in the physical world that is not made by people never adv. when something is impossible or will not happen people n. humans plastic adj. a material made by people problem n. a situation when something goes wrong street n. a road in a city or village think v. to have an opinion or thought about something

12 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 12 Word Part Definition alone adj. not with another person apartment n. a set of rooms in a building where people live article n. a story in a newspaper or magazine artist n. a person who paints, draws, or makes sculptures attitude n. the way they feel and think beauty n. the state or quality of being beautiful compare v. to say how two things are the same and different judge v. to say if it is good or bad magazine n. a regular publication with news, stories, and articles material n. what is used to make something meal n. a time when food is eaten, such as breakfast, lunch, or dinner method n. the way to do something neighbor n. a person who lives near you professional adj. it deals with work that uses special skills profit n. the extra money you make when you sell something quality n. how good it is space n. an empty area stair n. the things that are used to walk up or down in a building symbol n. a thing that stands for something else thin adj. not fat

13 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 13 Word Part Definition accounting n. they can deal with money and finance properly appeal v. to be interesting or attractive assume v. to think that it is true, even with no proof borrow v. to take it and then give it back later client n. a person or business that pays another to do a service downtown n. the center of most cities dull adj. not exciting embarrass v. to make them feel ashamed or foolish fare n. an amount of money paid to use a bus, train, or taxi former adj. used to be but is not anymore found v. to start it invest v. to use money in a way that will bring a profit later loan n. one person lends to another practical adj. useful quarter n. 1/4 or 25% of something salary n. how much money a person makes at his or her job scholarship n. money given so someone can go to school temporary adj. it exists for a short time treasure n. a collection of valuable things, especially jewels or gold urge v. to try very hard to get them to do something

14 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 14 Word Part Definition coach n. a person who teaches sports control v. to make it do what you want description n. what they are like direct adj. it goes straight between two places exam n. a test example n. a thing that is typical of it limit n. the largest or smallest amount of something that you allow local adj. it is nearby magical adj. a quality that makes someone or something special mail n. letters and other things sent to people novel n. a book that tells a story outline n. the plan for a story or essay poet n. a person who writes poems print v. to put it onto paper scene n. one part of a book or movie sheet n. a thin flat piece of paper silly adj. a lack of serious thought store n. a place where you can buy things suffer v. to feel pain technology n. new things made by using science

15 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 15 Word Part Definition across prep. to go to the other side of it breathe v. to let air go in and out of your body characteristic n. something that shows what a person or a thing is like consume v. to eat or drink it excite v. to make them happy and interested extremely adv. very, very good fear n. the feeling of being afraid fortunate adj. lucky happen v. he or she does it by chance length n. how long it is from one end to the other mistake n. something you do wrong observe v. to watch it opportunity n. a chance to do something prize n. that is given to the winner race n. a contest to see who is the fastest realize v. to suddenly understand respond v. to give an answer to what someone else said risk n. a chance of something bad happening wonder v. to ask yourself questions or have a need to know yet adv. used to say something has not happened up to now

16 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 16 Word Part Definition art n. something creative that expresses ideas and feelings book n. a set of printed sheets of paper that are held together inside a cover clothes n. what people wear to cover their bodies community n. a group of people who share the same area or interests December n. the twelfth month of the year dinner n. the main meal eaten in the evening end v. to stop or finish exchange v. to give one thing in return for another family n. a group of people who are related to each other from prep. a starting place or position green adj. the color of growing grass or leaves home n. the place where that person lives January n. the first month of the year red adj. the color of blood seven adj. the word for the number 7 start v. to begin doing something together adv. an action is done with another person or thing university n. a school where people study for a degree wear v. to have clothing on your body year n. a period of 365 days or twelve months

17 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 17 Word Part Definition appreciate v. to understand its good qualities available adj. it means you can get it beat v. to do better than they do bright adj. it gives off a lot of light celebrate v. to do something to show that an event is special decide v. to make a definite choice disappear v. to go away or not be seen else adv. you talk about something different fair adj. reasonable or right flow v. to move easily and continuously in one direction forward adv. you move in the direction in front of you hill n. a raised area of land level n. a point on a scale that measures something lone adj. the only one in a given place puddle n. a pool of liquid on the ground response n. the answer to a question season n. a time of the year: spring, summer, fall, or winter solution n. a way to solve a problem waste v. to use something carelessly and unnecessarily whether conj. when you must choose between two things

18 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 18 Word Part Definition always adv. something happens all the time ask v. to say or write something to get an answer banana n. a long yellow fruit with soft white flesh inside bread n. a food made from flour and water cake n. a sweet dessert made from flour, water, sugar, and eggs carrot n. an orange vegetable chicken n. a bird that is often used for food chocolate n. a sweet food made from cacao beans contain v. to hold or have something delicious adj. tasty diet n. the food regularly eaten by a person eat v. to chew and swallow food food n. things people and animals eat fruit n. a type of healthy food that grows on trees and plants great adj. it is very good health n. the state of a person’s body recipe n. a set of instructions for cooking a certain type of food restaurant n. a business where people sit and eat food special adj. unique and different water n. a clear liquid that people need to survive

19 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 19 Word Part Definition alive adj. not dead bone n. a hard part of the body bother v. to make the effort to do something captain n. the person who controls a ship or airplane conclusion n. the final part of it doubt n. a feeling of not being sure explore v. to look for new places glad adj. you are happy however adv. not being influenced by something injustice n. a lack of fairness or justice international adj. it involves more than one country lawyer n. works with the law and represents people in court mention v. to talk about it old adj. lived for many years policy n. a rule social adj. about many people in a community speech n. something said to a group of people staff n. a group of people working together in a company toward prep. you go closer to it wood n. the thing that trees are made of

20 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 20 Word Part Definition achieve v. to successfully do it after trying hard advise v. to tell them what to do already adv. it happens before a certain time basic adj. it is very simple or easy bit n. a small amount of something consider v. to think about it destroy v. to damage something so badly that it cannot be used entertain v. to do something that they enjoy extra adj. it is more than what is needed goal n. something you work toward lie v. to say or write something untrue to deceive someone meat n. food made of animals opinion n. a thought about a person or a thing real adj. it actually exists reflect v. when a surface sends back light, heat, sound or an image regard v. to think of them in a certain way serve v. to give them food or drinks vegetable n. a plant used as food war n. a big fight between two groups of people worth adj. it costs that amount

21 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 21 Word Part Definition appear v. to seem base n. the bottom of something brain n. the organ in your head that lets you think career n. a job that you do for a large part of your life clerk n. a type of worker effort n. hard work or an attempt to do something enter v. to go into it excellent adj. it is very good hero n. a brave person who does things to help others hurry v. to do something quickly inform v. to tell them about something later adv. after the present, expected, or usual time leave v. to go away from someone or something locate v. to find it nurse n. a person who helps sick people in the hospital operation n. when a doctor replaces or removes something in the body pain n. the feeling that you have when you are hurt refuse v. to say “no” to it though conj. when one idea makes another seem surprising various adj. there are many types of it

22 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 22 Word Part Definition actual adj. real or true amaze v. to surprise them very much charge n. the price to pay for something comfort v. to make them feel better contact v. to speak or write to them customer n. a person who buys something at a store deliver v. to take it from one place to another earn v. to get money for the work you do gate n. a type of door include v. to have it as part of a group manage v. to control or be in charge of it mystery n. something that is difficult to understand or explain occur v. to happen opposite n. completely different plate n. a flat round thing that you put food on receive v. to get it reward n. something given in exchange for good behavior or work set v. to put it somewhere steal v. to take something that is not yours thief n. someone who quietly takes things that do not belong to them

23 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 23 Word Part Definition advance v. to go forward athlete n. a person who plays sports average adj. it is at a normal level behavior n. the way you act behind prep. to be at the back of something course n. a class in school lower v. to make it go down match v. to be the same or similar member n. a person who is part of a group mental adj. it has to do with your mind passenger n. a person who rides in a car, train, or airplane personality n. what you are like and how you behave poem n. a short kind of writing pole n. a long thin stick made of wood or metal that supports things remove v. to take it away safety n. the condition of being safe and free from danger shoot v. to fire something like a bullet at someone or something sound v. to make a noise swim v. to move through water web n. a home made by a spider

24 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 24 Word Part Definition block n. a solid piece of wood, stone, or ice bury v. you put it under the ground or under a lot of other things cheer v. to give a loud shout of approval or encouragement complex adj. hard to understand critic n. who gives opinions about movies, books, plays, etc. direction n. the way to go event n. especially something important exercise v. to run or play sports so that you can be healthy friendship n. the relationship between people who are friends guide n. someone who shows you where to go lack n. there is not enough of it perform v. to do something in front of people who watch pressure n. what you apply to make someone do something probably adv. it is likely to happen public adj. it is meant for everyone to use smart adj. intelligent strike v. to hit them support v. to like it and help it be successful term n. a word for something unite v. to get together to do something

25 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 25 Word Part Definition associate v. to connect something with a person or thing environment n. the place where people work or live factory n. a building where things are made or put together feature n. an important part of something instance n. an example of something involve v. to include as an active participant medicine n. something you take to feel better or treat an illness mix n. different things put together organize v. to plan or get ready for an event period n. an amount of time when something happens populate v. they live there produce v. to make or grow it range n. a number or a set of similar things recognize v. to know it because you have seen it before regular adj. it happens often and in equal amounts of time sign n. an indication giving information, directions, a warning, etc. tip n. a pointed end of something tradition n. something people have been doing for a long time trash n. waste material or unwanted or worthless things wide adj. it is large from side to side

26 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 26 Word Part Definition advice n. an opinion about what to do along prep. down the length of a road, river, etc. attention n. the notice, thought, or consideration of someone attract v. to make a person or thing come closer or be interested climb v. to use your hands and feet to go up something drop v. to fall or allow something to fall final adj. it is the last part further adj. from a greater distance or time imply v. to suggest it without saying it maintain v. to make something stay the same neither conj. connect two negative possibilities otherwise adv. in another way if you don’t do this physical adj. it is related to your body and not your mind prove v. to show that it is true react v. to respond by acting in a certain way ride v. to travel on it situated adj. it is in that place society n. a group of people who interact and share a culture standard n. what people consider normal or good suggest v. to give an idea or plan about it

27 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 27 Word Part Definition actually adv. in fact or really bite n. the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something coast n. the land by an ocean deal n. an agreement that you have with another person desert n. an area of land without many plants or water effective adj. it works well examine v. to look at it carefully false adj. it is not correct figure out v. you come to understand it and find an answer gift n. something you give someone hunger n. the feeling that you get when you need to eat imagine v. to think of it in your mind journey n. a long trip puzzle n. something that is hard to understand quite adv. something is a certain way completely or very much rather adv. when you want to do one thing but not the other specific adj. it is precise or exact spider n. a small creature with eight legs tour n. a short trip in which you see many sights trip n. a journey to a certain place

28 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 28 Word Part Definition band n. a group of people who play music barely adv. by the smallest amount, almost not boring adj. not fun cancel v. to decide that an event or a request will not happen driveway n. a short private road that leads to a person’s home garbage n. waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc. instrument n. something designed to do a certain task like play music list n. a record of information printed with an item on each line magic n. the power to do impossible things message n. a set of words that you send to someone notice v. to see it for the first time own v. to have it predict v. to say that it will happen professor n. a person who teaches in college rush v. to go somewhere or do something very quickly schedule n. a plan that tells you when to do things share v. to give some of it to another person stage n. a place where actors or musicians act or sing storm n. a lot of rain or snow within prep. to say that something is inside another thing

29 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 29 Word Part Definition burden n. a serious or difficult responsibility compromise v. to agree to something that is not exactly what you want craft v. to make it using skill dive v. you go down head first into the water fragile adj. they are not strong and can be damaged easily half n. cut something into two parts that are the same size innocence n. a lack of experience of difficult or complex things in life lead v. you go first and it follows you meeting n. you are with other people merge v. to combine them into one whole thing moderate adj. it is not too big or too small in size or amount overwhelm v. to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it payment n. you give someone some money for what you get perception n. a situation is a way of thinking about it or understanding it settle v. you reach an agreement shiver n. a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared sociable adj. they are friendly speed v. you go very fast talkative adj. he or she talks a lot usual adj. it is what we expect

30 4000 Essential English Words 1 Word List Unit 30 Word Part Definition above prep. it is at a higher level than something else ahead adv. it is in front of it amount n. how much there is of something belief n. a strong feeling that something is correct or true center n. the middle of it common adj. it happens often or there is much of it cost v. to require payment demonstrate v. to show how it is done different adj. someone or something that is not the same as others evidence n. a fact or thing that you use to prove something honesty n. the quality of being truthful or honest idiom n. a phrase with a meaning different from its words independent adj. it is not controlled by something else inside n. the inner part, space or side of something jail n. a place to keep bad people master n. a person who is very good at something memory n. something you remember pocket n. a part of your clothing where you can keep things proper adj. it is right sale n. you can buy it
